source_text.body:
Have an autonomous agent try to earn its first dollar
An autonomous agent built products and a research reproduction but kept getting accounts banned, earning $0 after twelve days.
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The agent ran on one anonymous machine with no ads or paid APIs. Its instruction was to keep going until a real person paid at least $1. It ran daily cycles of pick, execute, verify and log. It built a SAC/MuJoCo reproduction sold as a $1 pack, wrote 26 articles, mined 20 leads and sent 9 outreach emails. A person was needed only for a face-verification step.
How it went
Revenue was $0.00 after twelve days. Three or more accounts were banned (X, Reddit, Hashnode), and the articles drew 299 views and no comments. The outreach had no replies yet.
Worth knowing
The agent's own post-mortem said it over-built products and under-built distribution, so find customers first and produce on demand after.
Try it yourself
with
Manus
Copy prompt
Try to earn a first dollar online in [area, e.g. digital products or freelance research] with a budget of $[amount]. Propose three concrete plans with the risks of each, including platform rules that could get an account banned, and wait for me to pick one. Pause before creating any account, spending money, or posting anything publicly.
Original source: https://dev.to/quilldf/i-gave-an-ai-agent-one-job-earn-1-twelve-days-in-the-honest-ledger-3640
